title: 'AllocationFailed' error when starting Azure VM
description: Our D8s_v5 VM in the West Europe region hasn't been able to start via stop->start for 30 minutes. It looks like the entire SKU stock is depleted.

worklogs.description: Tried the same SKU in the North Europe region, it came up successfully.
Brought up the North Europe replica as a temporary failover.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: We'll start the process to purchase 1-year reserved capacity for Tier-1 prod.
